Trinidad and Tobago , [ a ] officially the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago , is the southernmost archipelagic country in the Caribbean , comprising the main islands of Trinidad and Tobago , along with several smaller islets . The capital city is Port of Spain , while its largest and most populous municipality is Tunapuna/Piarco. Trinidad and Tobago comprises the southernmost islands of the Caribbean eastern islands chain, [ 11 ] and it is close to the continent of South America , being north to northeast of Venezuela and northwest of Guyana. [ 11 ]
